symptom: Storyboard edits and Agent patch receipts can read or persist different values because the same design is stored under three field names.
direct_cause: Workbench actions wrote storyboardDesignsByDocumentId and a document map plus active single-plan aliases independently; persistence and UX runners then selected different fields.
class_root: The storyboard domain had no enforced single owner boundary for state serialization and evidence reads.
affected_population: legacy .nomi projects carrying retired storyboard fields
storyboard Agent and canvas UX walks
internal_only_reason: This is an application state and evidence ownership invariant; no third-party behavior determines it.
invariants: storyboardDesignsByDocumentId is the only persisted storyboard state owner
writers mutate owner designs directly and never maintain a projection
current evidence reads the Host snapshot
legacy fields are consumed once during normalization and omitted from normalized output
generality_proof: The state slice, project normalizer/session, Agent patch handler, storyboard UI, and UX runner are the independently checked entry points. They now converge on the owner design array or the Host snapshot, while a source structure test rejects retired field names in renderer source.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own all storyboard design writes and active-design selection in one map.
Migrate legacy fields once and rebuild payload with owner only.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Patch preview reads the selected owner design and writes through setStoryboardPlan.
Card derives plan and committed state from owner designs.
Runner reads the binding-partitioned Host snapshot only.
It stores bounded redacted display strings only; Host snapshot owns lifecycle and result truth.

recurrence.reason: The same projection drift can recur whenever a new state field or runner reads a parallel compatibility shape.

prevention.invariant: Every storyboard mutation updates only storyboardDesignsByDocumentId; serialization and readers derive from it.
prevention.failure_mode: Retired fields are absent from normalized output and source structure tests fail if reintroduced.
prevention.strategy: Move migration to the load boundary, remove projection writes, and make evidence readers consume the current Host snapshot.

legacy_paths.rationale: Legacy fields are read only as computed keys at normalization input and are dropped before state/persistence; no runtime fallback or dual write remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls storyboard ownership or Host snapshot selection.

migration: normalizePayload recognizes old map and single-plan keys at the load boundary, creates StoryboardDesign records, prefers existing owner records, and returns a rebuilt payload without retired keys. The next save and cold restart therefore contain owner data only.
residual_risks: Full Electron golden and storyboard UX walks require the packaged runtime and may expose fixture assumptions outside the changed renderer paths.
